blurb: This check looks for a Shared Storage Pool alert threshold on a VIOS and is separate from ssp_cluster. No cluster is not applicable. ioscli cluster -status does not report ThresholdPercent (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/power7/8231-E1D?topic=commands-cluster-command). IBM documents that field on alert -list, which this check does not run. A configured cluster is not assessed, and no threshold number is graded.
